title: Decrease Safety Margin to Improve Maneuverability
statement: Reducing the safety margin will allow the robot to get closer to the obstacles, potentially enabling tighter turns and smoother traversal.
mechanism: A smaller safety margin means the robot will operate closer to the obstacles, which can improve its maneuverability in tight spaces.
